Name: Kenneth's Knight Swords
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Knight Swords[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]12 classic knight swords for Kenneth's Weapon Shop. Steel and gold guards, clean knight look, good for everyday mine runs[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]12 swords in Shop5, all with that classic knight feel. Some are light and fast, some are steady for everyday use, and some are heavy and hit hard. Short blades, classic knight swords, sabers, a katana, and broadswords are in there[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Check Shop5 in game when you have time, and see which one fits how you play[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to buy[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Weapon Shop - Shop5[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Each sword is sold once a day. You buy it with gold plus bars / gems, so bring both when you stop by[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to play[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Go to Kenneth's Weapon Shop, Shop5[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Take a look at what is for sale[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Buy the one you like. Shop only, no quests, no crafting[/b][/size]

[b][size=4]What you need[/size][/b]
[size=4][b]• Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• SMAPI[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Weapon Shop - you need this so Shop5 shows up[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to install[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher first[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Put this mod in your Mods folder[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Make sure Kenneth's Weapon Shop is also installed[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]4. Start the game and check Shop5[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with other mods?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Yeah. Works with the other swords from Kenneth's Weapon Shop. You can add it in the middle of a save, no need to start a new game[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
